title_zh: 请接待员转达债务咨询表的填写疑问

scenario.label_zh: 核对债务咨询表的信息要求
scenario.goal_zh: 询问表格要求并约定向咨询员确认如何填写尚不确定的金额

context_zh: 虚构免费债务咨询服务的来电者询问首次会面前的表格要求；不讨论借贷或还款建议。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: The form asks me to declare every amount I owe. Does that include money borrowed from a relative?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I'll ask the adviser to clarify that. Is there another part of the form you're unsure about?

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: There's one debt where I don't know the current balance. I have the last statement, but it may be out of date.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I can tell the adviser that too. Please don't send account details to this general reception address.

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: Thank you. Could you ask how I should record an amount that hasn't been confirmed?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: Yes. I'll request guidance on both questions and ask the adviser to contact you before your appointment.

sentences.speaker: Olive
sentences.text: That's all I need for now. I'll wait for that clarification before completing those sections.
